query:
UPDATE faturamentos 
SET cat9 = ROUND(29699.56 / 15, 2)
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' 
  AND data LIKE '2026-07%' 
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(data, 9, 2) AS UNSIGNED) <= 15;
